name: Lanterns [HALLOWEEN!]
desc:
[BETA]
💍 CHOOSE YOUR RING. MASTER ITS POWER. PROTECT THE UNIVERSE.

Choose your Corps, equip powerful construct abilities, and fight your way through criminals, alien raiders, deadly machines, and powerful enemies across multiple cities and worlds.

⚡ Unlock new abilities  
✈️ Fly freely through the world  
💥 Create powerful energy constructs  
🥊 Fight enemies and challenging bosses  
📈 Level up Health, Stamina, and Damage  
🌎 Travel to stronger cities and planets  

The stronger you become, the greater the threats you'll face.

Do you have what it takes to become one of the universe's strongest ring wielders?

⭐ Favorite the game for future updates!
👍 Like the game if you want more abilities, enemies, and worlds!
